after.zh: 热图给人看，一个数给流水线用：上线前把每个模型在一批照片上跑一遍，比例低的先拦下来。这批照片里车和路总在一起，所以分数高不说明模型学对了，要看它为什么高。
after.en: The heat map is for people to look at, the number for the pipeline: before release, every model runs over a batch of photos, and the ones with a low fraction are held back. In these photos cars and roads always go together, so a high score does not show the model learnt the right thing; what matters is why it is high.

t.zh: 最后把检查做成一份报告：一张热图给人看，一个数给流水线判断要不要拦下这个模型。
t.en: Finally the check becomes a report: a heat map for people to look at, and a number for the pipeline to decide whether to hold the model back.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：两个输出，热图是灰块遮挡图（3×3）；热图落在车上的比例不到一半就输出 1，否则输出 0。
t.en: Your task in this level: two outputs; the heat map is the grey 3×3 occlusion map, and the number is 1 if less than half of it lies on the car, 0 otherwise.

caption.zh: 第二组：只看路的分类器
caption.en: Set 2: a classifier that looks at the road

brief.zh: 给每个分类器出一份报告：一张灰块遮挡图（3×3），和一个数——热图大于 0 的部分落在车上的不到 0.5，就输出 1（它靠背景认车），否则输出 0。
brief.en: Write a report on each classifier: a grey 3×3 occlusion map, and a number: 1 if less than 0.5 of the heat map's part above 0 lies on the car (it recognises cars by the background), 0 otherwise.

hint.zh: 「不到」和<part-ref to="threshold"></part-ref>说的「超过」正好相反。
hint.en: "Less than" is the exact opposite of the "above" that <part-ref to="threshold"></part-ref> answers.
